paper.title: Advancing Forest Monitoring and Assessment Through Immersive Virtual Reality

codecheck.summary:
The data of the paper under reproduction is partially published on Zenodo under a CC-BY-4.0 license.
Data on the selected plots displayed in Figure 1 is not available due to intellectual property concerns.
The developed VR application is not available due to size and time constraints, therefore neither Figure 1 or 2 could be reproduced.
Statistical analyses presented in Section 2.2 and Section 3 have been successfully reproduced.
The authors showed dedication to support reproducibility of their work.
Reproduction was partially successful.
